mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_handoff_action_receipts (tenant_id, command_id, ticket_id, operator_id, action, expected_revision, fingerprint) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{command} AS uuid), #{ticket}, #{operator}, #{action}, #{revision}, #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id, operator_id, action, expected_revision, fingerprint FROM nw_handoff_action_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND command_id = CAST(#{command} AS uuid)
